verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, no bulk download of account data, and no open-format export path. API and MCP read access to records like certificates, transactions and nexus are developer building blocks for building an export, not the export capability itself. The month-to-month, no-contract terms only address commercial lock-in, not taking your data with you.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
